import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy.sparse import hstack
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.ensemble import HistGradientBoostingClassifier
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sub_template = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")


# Clean text: strip quotes, normalize whitespace, lowercase
def clean_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    return " ".join(str(text).strip().strip('"').replace("\n", " ").lower().split())


train_df["Comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)
test_df["Comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(clean_text)

# Feature extraction: word and character n-gram TF-IDF
word_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=25000, sublinear_tf=True, min_df=2
)
char_vec = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char_wb",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    max_features=25000,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    min_df=2,
)

X_train_full = hstack(
    [
        word_vec.fit_transform(train_df["Comment"]),
        char_vec.transform(train_df["Comment"]),
    ]
)
y_train_full = train_df["Insult"]

X_test = hstack(
    [word_vec.transform(test_df["Comment"]), char_vec.transform(test_df["Comment"])]
)

# Strict hold-out validation split
X_train_val, X_val, y_train_val, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

# Train model on validation split only
model = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
    max_iter=200, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.1, random_state=42
)
model.fit(X_train_val, y_train_val)

# Evaluate on hold-out set
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Retrain on full training data for final test predictions
model_final = HistGradientBoostingClassifier(
    max_iter=200, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.1, random_state=42
)
model_final.fit(X_train_full, y_train_full)

test_probs = model_final.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Format and save submission
submission = sub_template.copy()
submission["Insult"] = test_probs

os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully to ./submission/submission.csv")
